    The EA FC 27 Team Of The Week 2 also known as TOTW2 was released on 2026-09-23 and includes 23 players with prices ranging from 10,250 to 1,650,000 on Playstation and XBOX. PC prices are ranging from 10,250 to 2,100,000.

    The total squad price is 4,246,750 on Playstation and XBOX and 5,196,000 on PC. The Team Of The Week 2 includes 1 goalkeeper, 5 defenders, 11 midfielders, 1 winger and 5 forwards.

    The lowest rated player in the squad has a rating of 80 and the highest rated player is 91. See all Team Of The Weeks and Promotional squads here
